xmldoc.short_description: Create radio button in a button group.

description.p: rb = uiradiobutton(bg) creates a radio button inside a uibuttongroup. The first button added to a group is selected. Selection is exclusive; changes are reported by the group SelectionChangedFcn. Properties: Value (logical), Text, WordWrap, fonts.
